assessment.question:
### Exercise 17.1: Choose the best way to collect data

1. Babangida wants to find out her classmates' favourite television programme.

What one of the following should Babangida do?

- Look up the answer in the newspaper.
- Observe everyone in her class when they are watching television.
- Draw up a questionnaire asking which of the given ten television programmes was their favourite and hand it out to her classmates to complete.
assessment.expected_answer:
Babangida won't find out about the favourite television programme of her classmates in a newspaper.

Observing all her classmates when they watch television will be too time consuming, and won't necessarily tell her which programme is their favourite.

Answer: Babangida should draw up a questionnaire and then give it to her classmates to complete.
